canonical_name: Stable manifold theorem for a hyperbolic equilibrium (catalog family label; exact proposition open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 双曲平衡点的稳定与不稳定流形
literal_source_claim_en: stable and unstable manifolds of a hyperbolic equilibrium
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected smooth dynamical system with a hyperbolic equilibrium, construct the source-selected local or global stable and unstable manifolds and prove exactly the required graph, smoothness, tangency, dimension, invariance, convergence, exponential-estimate, uniqueness, and stable-set identification clauses.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not fix continuous-time vector-field dynamics versus a diffeomorphism, phase space, regularity, hyperbolicity and spectral-splitting predicates, local versus global leaves, orbit and convergence definitions, embedded versus immersed status, conclusion bundle, time directions, or boundary cases. Selecting a familiar stable-manifold formulation would add proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix continuous or discrete time, finite-dimensional real space, smooth manifold, Banach space/manifold or another phase space, its universes and scalar field, charted and completeness structures, and the domain on which the dynamics and leaves exist.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not say whether the result asserts local graph/manifold existence alone, both stable and unstable branches, smoothness and dimensions, tangency, local or global invariance, exponential estimates, uniqueness, equality with stable/unstable sets, or a conjunction of these clauses.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a local continuous-time theorem for a C^k vector field on a finite-dimensional real phase space near a hyperbolic equilibrium
a local stable/unstable graph theorem over the spectral subspaces with smoothness, tangency, invariance, and exponential estimates
an identification of local or global stable/unstable sets with the constructed manifolds under hyperbolicity
a discrete-time theorem for a C^k diffeomorphism near a hyperbolic fixed point
a Hadamard-Perron theorem on a Banach space or a normally hyperbolic invariant-manifold theorem
a nonuniform stable-manifold theorem in Pesin theory
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; every listed trivial-subspace, time-direction, completeness, orbit-domain, embedding, and zero-dimensional case must be resolved by the statement phase.
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: purely stable or purely unstable hyperbolic linearizations and zero-dimensional stable or unstable subspaces
a zero-dimensional phase space and the equilibrium's membership in both leaves
the zero vector field, which fails the ordinary positive-dimensional hyperbolicity condition
semiflows without negative time and incomplete vector fields whose orbits are not globally defined
empty or source-restricted chart neighborhoods and local versus global orbit existence
whether global leaves are embedded, injectively immersed, immersed with self-intersection, or only set-theoretic
real versus complex spectral splitting and how conjugate eigenvalues are represented
boundary or corner points if the phase space is a manifold with boundary
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1345 Hartman-Grobman, THM-M-1347 center manifolds, or a Lyapunov stability criterion
THM-M-1411 hyperbolic systems, THM-M-1414 Anosov flows, or THM-M-1420 Pesin theory
the distinct physics target THM-P-0744 silently substituted for this mathematics target
linear stable and unstable spectral-subspace invariance presented as the nonlinear manifold theorem
local ODE existence, one convergent orbit, an invariant-set definition, or a smooth-embedding API presented as the root
a structure field or hypothesis that assumes the target graph, manifold, invariance, tangency, convergence estimate, or set equality
a numerical trajectory or phase portrait used as theorem evidence
